q: What should an EU importer ask an Egyptian urea supplier for under CBAM?
title: EU importers: Egyptian urea data
short: The installation's direct and indirect emissions per tonne of urea, including the ammonia used as a precursor, for the reporting period, with the monitoring method. Fertilisers count indirect emissions from electricity under CBAM, unlike steel and aluminium.
audience: EU importers and declarants buying urea from Egyptian producers

p: Specific direct and indirect embedded emissions per tonne.
The ammonia precursor's emissions and where it came from.
The verifier's report once actual values are declared in the definitive period.

sections.h: If the data does not come
p: The declarant uses the Commission's default values, which carry mark-ups.
